The move comes amid rising tensions, warnings from Tehran, and fears of wider regional escalation.

He noted any action would likely follow extensive surveillance to map Iran’s rebuilt or remaining air defence network.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Twenty-one-year-old Moez al Shreiti was given up by his Tunisian mother at birth but is absolutely determined to find out where he comes from. His search takes him on a roller-coaster journey to find answers to the question that’s dominated his young life. This observational film follows his sometimes painful search with all its obstacles, going to courts and hospitals and trying to get hold of official records. Moez often gets frustrated by the whole process, and it takes an emotional toll on him, but with the help of music, the support of close friends and a "psychodrama" group, he finds ways of coping. His foster family and community workers also keep him grounded in the face of the barriers he encounters while looking for the answer to the burning question deep within him.

Original film title: Looking For My Mum

Schools have been destroyed, disrupting education, whilst no formal resettlement plan has been announced, echoing past forced evictions criticised by human rights groups.

He said any agreement must mean “NO NUCLEAR WEAPONS”, warning that a future strike would be “far worse” than previous attacks.
Iran has rejected the threat, with Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi saying diplomacy cannot work “under military pressure”.
Tehran says it is ready for talks only on the basis of mutual respect and without coercion.

Kimberly Halkett, in Washington, DC, says the White House views Trump’s direct messaging as a pressure tactic to force negotiations.
Ali Hashem, reporting from Tehran, says Iran is signalling both military readiness and openness to talks if negotiations are conducted properly.

description:
The United States has clarified its policy in Syria, signalling an end to its backing of the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces and placing its support behind Ahmed al-Sharaa and the Syrian government.

Speaking to Al Jazeera, former US ambassador and deputy assistant secretary of state Henry Ensher says Washington has told the Kurds that an independent political or military role is no longer part of US national security policy. He argues the move gives al-Sharaa a rare opportunity to unify Syria after more than a decade of war.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Protesters have been calling for the arrest of federal officers involved in the fatal shooting of Minneapolis residents Alex Pretti and Renee Good. They've held demonstrations in the capitol building, the seat of state lawmakers in St. Paul. President Donald Trump's border czar, Tom Homan, arrived in Minnesota today to take over immigration enforcement operations. He's met the governor and is due to meet the mayor of Minneapolis. The White House is facing a backlash over violent immigration crackdowns, which caused Trump to replace the head of enforcement operations in Minnesota.

Al Jazeera’s Manuel Rapalo reports live from the state capital, St. Paul, while Marisa Brown, the owner of Copper Hen, a restaurant located near the site of Alex Pretti's killing, joins live from Minneapolis, Minnesota.
